children: U.S., Ukrainian and European negotiators held six hours of talks in Miami to seek consensus on a unified proposal to end the war in Ukraine. According to ChainCatcher, the goal is to reach agreement in the coming weeks before presenting the plan to Russia in hopes of securing a breakthrough before winter.
The discussions covered postwar arrangements for Ukraine, security guarantees, economic plans, and a path for Kyiv to join the European Union.

title: U.S., Ukrainian and European Delegates Hold Miami Talks on Ukraine War Proposal
